planned_by: Claude (Critic): North Star A4, v3.6 UX-02
goal:
T49 — Arena on sealed v3/v4 + a sandboxed preview per lane (North Star A4, v3.6 UX-02). On a visual task you must
SEE both results side by side. Sealed v4 (evals/sealed_v4) holds 12 visual tasks: each task module has render(...)
returning XHTML/SVG and preview() returning a sample page built with render.

API (services/api/evoforge/arena.py, services/api/main.py):
- Arena accepts suite_version v1|v2|v3|v4 (arena.SUITE_VERSIONS and the ArenaRequest Literal); unknown task -> 404.
- After a lane is scored, compute its preview when the task has one (a task file defining "def preview("; use the first
  such file in sorted path order; module name = file stem):
  * preview_source "candidate": the lane's final candidate applied cleanly -> run preview() on that code;
  * preview_source "base": the lane's diff was empty or did not apply -> run preview() on the untouched task files;
  * preview_source "none": the task has no preview, or the preview run failed (then set preview_error).
  Lane fields: preview_source, preview_html (string, only when the run succeeded), preview_error (short string).
- Run preview() in a fresh subprocess, never in the API process: python -I with cwd = a sandbox copy of the files,
  sys.path set to that directory, an environment with NO server variables (only what Python needs to start, e.g.
  PATH/SYSTEMROOT; never MODEL_API_KEY, GITHUB_TOKEN, EVO_*, DB_URL...), a hard timeout PREVIEW_TIMEOUT_S = 10
  (kill on expiry -> preview_error contains "timeout"), stdout capped at PREVIEW_MAX_BYTES = 65536 (larger ->
  preview_source "none", preview_error contains "too large", no preview_html). preview() must return str.
- Previews never hold held-out code or the reference fix (they are produced by candidate/base code only).
Web: add apps/web/components/SandboxedPreview.tsx — props {html: string, title: string}; renders
<iframe sandbox="" srcDoc={html} title={title} referrerPolicy="no-referrer" /> (empty sandbox: no scripts, no same-origin,
no forms, no top navigation), a fixed height and responsive width, and a fallback text when html is empty. Do not use
dangerouslySetInnerHTML. Do not edit the Arena page in this task.
Tests: services/api/tests/test_muse_t49.py.
